checks: Existing Cloudflare transport receives callable schemas and same-input metering; paid allowance remains unused
Model-selected call arguments are preserved for the existing loop to validate, not rewritten by intent routing
Existing shared quota rejection dispatches no inference and creates no settlement retry
Authorization revoked after admission prevents dispatch and closes the reservation conservatively
Malformed model JSON preserves measured consumption and finishes failed exactly once
Mixed calls/final and malformed call envelopes are rejected after measured usage
Missing provider usage is not reported as measured zero and leaves conservative reservation accounting
Settlement failure never retries accounting or the provider
Abort and smaller output budgets reach transport without enabling extra output or calls
Existing knowledge and operational prose transports retain their prior wire shape and640-token bound
